title: Ge-Baek

note.p: Ge-Baek is named after Gyebaek, a great general of the Baekje kingdom (7th century). The diagram, a single line, stands for his severe and strict military discipline. The whole pattern stays on the C–D line, starting in parallel ready stance at its centre facing D: an X-knife-hand checking block and twisting kick; punches, rising and low blocks; a double arc-hand block looking toward AD; scooping blocks, punches and back fists in sitting stance on the diagonals; guarding blocks, low kicks and fingertip thrusts toward C; 9-shape blocks; a turning kick and flying side kick; an elbow strike into the palm and a jump into X-stance; reverse knife-hand and middle-knuckle strikes; stamping W-shape blocks; and rising blocks with punches to finish.

footer: Move numbers follow the ITF Encyclopedia count (44 movements, one technique each). The whole pattern is on the C–D line, so the board shows the moves in order, nine to a row, read down the page; the minimap shows roughly where each count is on the line. Directions use the ITF letters: you start facing D, with B on your left and A on your right; AD, AC, BD and BC are the diagonals. Finish by bringing the right foot back to parallel ready stance.

moves.desc: Stand at the centre of the C–D line facing D in parallel ready stance.
Move the right foot back toward C into a right L-stance facing D (left foot forward, weight on the right leg). X-knife-hand checking block.
Right low twisting kick toward D, the hands held where they were.
Lower the right foot toward D into a right walking stance. Right middle punch.
In the same stance, left middle punch, fast after 3.
Move the right foot back toward C into a left walking stance facing D. Left forearm rising block.
In the same stance, left forearm low block, flowing on from 5.
In the same stance, double arc-hand high block toward AD, looking through the hands.
Turn the face toward D, drawing the left foot up to the right knee into a right bending ready stance A.
Lower the left foot toward AD into a sitting stance facing AC. Left palm scooping block toward AC.
In the same stance, right middle punch toward AC, straight on from 9.
In the same stance, left back fist front strike toward AC.
Move the right foot onto the A–B line, then move the left foot to C into a right L-stance facing C (left foot forward, weight on the right leg). Knife-hand middle guarding block.
Left low side front snap kick toward C, the hands held where they were.
Lower the left foot toward C into a left low stance. Left flat fingertip high thrust.
In the same stance, right flat fingertip high thrust.
Right middle side piercing kick toward C, pulling both hands apart.
Lower the right foot toward C into a right L-stance facing D (left foot forward toward D, weight on the right leg). Forearm middle guarding block.
Move the right foot to D, turning counter-clockwise into a right L-stance facing C (left foot forward, weight on the right leg). Forearm middle guarding block.
Move the left foot to D, turning counter-clockwise into a right L-stance facing D (left foot forward, weight on the right leg). Knife-hand middle guarding block, with a kihap.
Move the left foot along the C–D line into a sitting stance facing A. Right 9-shape block.
Move the right foot to D, turning counter-clockwise into a left walking stance facing C. Left knife-hand low block.
Right middle turning kick toward BC, then lower the right foot toward C.
Jump: right flying side piercing kick toward C, fast after 22.
Land toward C in a right walking stance. Twin fist high vertical punch.
In the same stance, double arc-hand high block toward AC, looking through the hands.
In the same stance, left upset punch.
Move the right foot along the C–D line into a left walking stance facing D. Right front elbow strike into the left palm.
Jump toward D, landing in a right X-stance facing BD. Right double forearm high block toward D, with a kihap.
Move the left foot toward BC into a sitting stance facing BD. Right palm scooping block toward BD.
In the same stance, left middle punch toward BD, straight on from 29.
In the same stance, right back fist front strike toward BD.
Move the left foot to C into a left walking stance facing C. Right reverse knife-hand high front strike.
Move the left foot about half a shoulder width toward A, then right middle turning kick toward C.
Lower the right foot toward C, then pivoting on the right foot turn counter-clockwise into a left walking stance facing D. Twin fist high vertical punch.
Pull the left foot back into a right L-stance facing D (left foot forward, weight on the right leg). Right middle knuckle fist middle punch, the left side fist in front of the right shoulder.
Move the right foot toward D into a sitting stance facing B. Left 9-shape block.
In the same stance, reverse knife-hand low guarding block toward C.
In the same stance, knife-hand low guarding block toward D, straight on from 37.
Stamp the left foot toward D into a sitting stance facing A. W-shape block.
Stamp the left foot toward C into a sitting stance facing B. W-shape block.
Move the right foot to C into a right walking stance facing C. Right forearm rising block.
In the same stance, left middle punch.
Move the right foot along the C–D line into a left walking stance facing D. Left forearm rising block.
In the same stance, right middle punch.
